text: A place where handmaidens train and tend animals, rich with flora and a great variety of creatures.
The residence of the handmaidens, where they live, equipped with all manner of facilities to more easily protect the Queen of Avalon.
Some elves of the Athel Loren forest, endlessly nostalgic for life in Ulthuan's bay, chose to return near Avalon through the world roots and establish temporary dwellings.
The elves of Athel Loren, upon returning to Ulthuan's bay, retained their habit of forest dwelling, continuing their life in the forests of Avalon.
The returning elves discovered a bountiful valley to make their home, allowing the creatures of Athel Loren to adapt more easily to their new life.
Chrace is the province with the greatest number of White Lions in all of Ulthuan's bay, and most of them dwell here.
Legend holds that the White Lion Temple is a sacred ground guarded jointly by retired White Lion guards and elite White Lions, sacred and inviolable.
Only White Lion guards who have earned the recognition of Rahagra, Father of the White Lions, may come here to adopt a special White Lion.
The elves of Cothique raise sea creatures, living and fighting alongside them.
To guard Ulthuan's bay against any incursion of evil, Cothique has established various deep sea outposts.
For elves devoted to Mathlann, God of the Sea, this is their most sacred place.
